title: Faction Champion creation/attack
historicalOriginalText: CJ5-07-A: A genuinely positive-standing faction qualifies at creation. The one champion's commanded attack uses Wizard+8and rolls2d8=11plusPB4for15slashing, with no extra companion attack granted. Its apparent shield and armor are intrinsicAC18, not two free sellable items taken from a distant faction armory.

Owner BA command; Champion Strike attack uses+8 and hits; 2d8=11 + PB4 =15 slashing.
Intrinsic shield/armor remain profile manifestation, not inventory.
currentAdjudication: One finite Champion; no extra companion Action/items/real NPC transport.

title: Champion cap, standing drift and cargo
historicalOriginalText: CJ5-07-B: The caster cannot create one champion from each of three friendly factions to gain three source slots; this spell permits one per owner across all factions. An actual later standing decrease does not duplicate or teleport a real officer into its body. On expiry a genuinely borrowed lantern drops intact, while the manifested weapon leaves no harvestable item or NPC corpse.
currentInitialState: Caster has three friendly factions but only one live Champion. Existing Champion carries genuine borrowed lantern and intrinsic manifested weapon. Standing later drops.
actionsAndResolution: Spell permits one Champion per owner across all factions; second successful formation replaces first rather than adds another.
Later ordinary standing loss does not remotely end already admitted body.
At source expiry body ends; real lantern drops/settles at last legal position; intrinsic weapon vanishes.
currentAdjudication: No teleported officer, corpse/loot, faction stock duplication or source-slot multiplication.
evidenceKind: authored adjudication example; not runtime/human/balance test

previousCurrentVersion.title: Null-disabled Faction Champion and source expiry
previousCurrentVersion.currentInitialState: Wizard9 owns live Faction Champion HP6/70 carrying genuine 2-lb lantern; source concentration deadline t60. Qualifying Null packet deals12 at t6. Cleric1 WIS+3, S1,M3,R P6 later heals.
actionsAndResolution: t6: Null packet produces same Champion Disabled0 rather than finite-summon disappearance; lantern remains genuine cargo.
t12: Cleric spends Action+2RP; Healing Rite 1d8=5 +3 =8 -> Champion HP8/70, clearing Disabled.
t60: concentration deadline ends Champion body. Intrinsic armor/weapon vanish; genuine lantern remains and drops/settles at last legal position.
previousCurrentVersion.currentAdjudication: No NPC corpse/loot or source-duration refresh is created.

currentInitialState: Parallel fixtures use the same live Faction Champion HP6/70 with genuine2-lb lantern and source deadline t60. Branch N receives qualifying nullNonlethal12. Branch O receives ordinary non-Null12. Cleric1 WIS+3, S1/M3, RP6 is present only in N.
actionsAndResolution: N t6: qualifying Null packet reduces Champion to0 and uses finite-summon branch: same body becomes Disabled0, lantern stays genuine cargo, source deadline unchanged.

N t12: Cleric spends Action+2RP Healing Rite; roll1d8=5 +M3 =8, Champion becomes8/70 and Disabled ends. t60 independent source end removes body; intrinsic gear vanishes and lantern drops/settles normally.

O t6: ordinary non-Null packet reduces finite summon to0; its profile/source normal endpoint immediately ends/disappears the Champion body. Genuine lantern remains. There is no body at t12 to heal and no t60 second disappearance.
currentAdjudication: Null changes only the damage-caused finite-summon zero endpoint; ordinary lethal damage uses the profile’s ordinary disappearance. No source-duration refresh or corpse/loot.

title: Faction Champion gate is distinct
currentInitialState: Caster has Faction A standing+2 but no alliedStatus/invocation permission; Faction B membership+standing+1+invocation permission but alliedStatus not recorded; Faction C alliedStatus=true, standing+1, invocation permission, no aid ban.
actionsAndResolution: A fails AC5-CHAMPION-ALLY-01 despite positive standing.
B fails because membership/permission does not manufacture Champion alliedStatus.
C passes and can be chosen before payment if all ordinary cast/space gates pass.
currentAdjudication: Faction Ally and Faction Portal credentials remain distinct from Champion gate.

title: Elemental Banishment source expiry, cargo, rider, endpoint blocker
currentInitialState: Hostile summoned Champion C carries genuine lantern L and physically carries separate willing Small creature R. C source expires at t30. C fails CHA at t0; origin is under no Anchor initially. At t20 Dimensional Anchor is established over C's origin return endpoint.
actionsAndResolution: Before exile separate creature R is not gear; R remains origin-plane. C+legal noncreature lantern L transit into AC5-BANISH-EXT cell.
t20 Anchor begins over return endpoint; exile continues.
t30 Champion's independent summon source expires: body ends; intrinsic gear vanishes; genuine lantern remains loose. Elemental Banishment ends immediately because body source ended.
AC5-BANISH-EXT closes cell. Terminal Banishment blocker exception ignores only Anchor prevention for mandatory cargo return; L returns/settles once. C is not recreated and R never moved.
currentAdjudication: Source expiry outranks exile duration; real cargo preserved; separate creature never becomes gear.
evidenceKind: authored adjudication example; not runtime/human/balance test
